name: Refine draft emails for professional communication
description: Users asked the AI to edit, refine, or rewrite draft emails to enhance their professionalism, clarity, and tone for various recipients and contexts, including business colleagues, academic supervisors, and official authorities. The requests frequently involved adjusting formality, correcting grammar, or restructuring content to suit specific purposes such as visa inquiries, recruitment, project updates, and formal correspondence.
